resources.string: Pairing could not be removed (storage full?): %1$s
TV connection failed. Open both apps and select the TV again.
TV unreachable: this phone is not on the same network. Join the TV\'s Wi-Fi or enable VPN access under Availability and network.
Local network unavailable. Check network permission and Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
Invalid invitation. Scan a new QR code on the TV.
Cannot play this item on the TV. Check that the same media source is configured there.
The phone wants to play a title from %1$s, which is not the active server on this TV.
Share exactly one YouTube link or direct HTTP(S) media link, such as MP4, M3U8, MP3 or FLAC. Web pages and local files are not supported.
This TV target is no longer paired. Please pair it again.
On the TV, open Settings → Network → Phone & TV → Pair phone. Scan the QR code or enter that TV’s code.
Scan with your phone camera, or enter the code below in Ambient TV on the phone. Valid for two minutes. Then compare the codes on both devices.
Compare the code on both devices. Only confirm if both codes match.
%1$s · enter the code shown on this TV
Enter the eight-character code from the TV screen.
Wrong pairing code. Please try again.
Too many wrong codes. Open pairing on the TV again.
Point the camera at the QR code on the TV.
Camera access is needed to scan the code. You can also enter the code from the TV instead.
The camera could not be opened. Please enter the code from the TV instead.
Playback did not start in time.
The saved queue could not be loaded.
The queue is still available, but could not be saved for a restart.
Looking for TVs on this Wi-Fi …
No TV found. Open Ambient TV on the TV, turn on Settings → Phone & TV → Allow connections on this TV, and keep both devices on the same Wi-Fi.
Allow access to the home network so the phone can find and reach the TV.
On the TV, open “Phone & TV” → “Pair phone”. Choose that TV here and enter its code.
Link with QR code or link
Asleep – will be woken when connecting
Afterwards the device has to be paired again.
%1$s is not reachable. Switch it on and open Ambient TV, or set up Wake-on-LAN/VPN in the connection settings.
Enter the code shown on this TV
Connection failed. Turn on the TV, open Ambient TV and reconnect.
%1$s wants to take over data from this TV
%1$s wants to take over data from this TV.
Caution: this data was exported on %1$s, before the last import on this device. Apply anyway?
The TV\'s data is transferred to this phone. The TV asks for confirmation first; display and audio settings are not taken over.
Waiting for the TV – confirm the request on the TV…
On the phone, open “Remote” → “Transfer data” and choose “TV → Phone”.
Choose a device – the app connects automatically (sleeping TVs are woken).
Only phones connected right now can receive data.
No TV reachable. Switch the TV on, open Ambient TV and enable “Allow connections on this TV” – or set up Wake-on-LAN/VPN in the connection settings.
No phone connected. Open “Remote” on the phone and choose this TV.
Connection failed – choose the device again to retry
Transfer failed: %1$s is not connected. Choose the device again.
Transfer not started: another transfer or confirmation is still open.
Transfer not started: save the open settings first.
Transfer refused by %1$s: open Ambient TV there in the foreground and update the app if needed.
Transfer not started: the data is too large (max. 512 KB).
Transfer failed: %1$s did not answer in time.
Transfer refused: a confirmation is still open on %1$s.
Import on %1$s failed; the previous settings were kept.
The data for %1$s could not be prepared.
